title: BEST IRON FARM Minecraft Tutorial - NEXT/GEN! - 100% Stable!
description:
In this Tutorial, I Will Show you how to make the next generation of iron farm the first iron farm that keeps everything stable* 4 iron golems spawn without any circuit or advanced setups just with dirt and one zombie that is trapped in a boat in the Minecraft

📝Important Details About the Farm:
📚This farm is based on the new gen of iron farms
📚In this version, used the 1 zombie and separated villagers' boxes which can increase the efficiency of the farm up 100% ( it means 100% possibility of the spawning of 4 iron golems each 7s

📚to keep the farm loaded use a chunk loader
📚this is the first iron farm modules that keep stable 100% noncircuit based!
